svg.title: LocalStack: AWS CLI commands against an emulated AWS
svg.desc: The model gets LocalStack instructions and two tools, aws_cli and localstack_health. An aws_cli command, given without the leading aws, is first checked against allowed_services or denied_services; a command that names a blocked service or passes --endpoint-url, --profile, --region or --no-sign-request is rejected. Otherwise the AWS CLI runs without a shell, with the endpoint, region and test credentials injected, against LocalStack at localhost.localstack.cloud:4566, and labelled stdout, stderr and exit code come back, keeping the tail when long. With manage_container=True the capability starts a LocalStack Docker container for the run, waits for its health check, and stops it when the run ends.
